system.description:
You spew your stained inner spirit outward and fuse your corpse-body with tangible darkness; your head and limbs fade into shadow, bands of blackness striate your torso, and tentacles sprout from your flesh.

Spend two Blood Traits and a Social Trait. You immediately grow four tentacles like those of Arms of the Abyss, but treated as extensions of yourself using your own Traits. Anyone you touch gains the Negative Trait Clumsy as supernatural cold numbs their limbs. You gain one extra attack with the tentacles at the end of each turn (added to your sequence, not multiplied by Celerity), the bonus Traits Intimidating x3, and immunity to all penalties from mundane darkness. The transformation lasts one scene or one hour.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
